historicalBriefUnmodified.name: Équipement d’infiltration contemporain
historicalBriefUnmodified.concept: Venus AC!D2, mêmes âge, proportions, coiffure et tenue officielle réinterprétée avec matières détaillées; aucune conversion en Quiet.

prompt.name: Équipement d’infiltration contemporain
prompt.prompt: Create ONE finished static 2D/2.5D game sprite, one complete character/entity, single neutral pose looking or oriented screen RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Entire silhouette within frame, at least5percent transparent margins, coherent physical weight and attachments. Truly transparent background. No backdrop, ground plane, cast shadow, haze, UI, text, labels, repeated views, comparison layout or sprite sheet. This is an original CQC costume/design, not a claim of official released-game outfit or recovery of old PNG bytes. VENUS from Metal Gear Acid2 in her ORIGINAL RED combat-armor appearance, in a new detailed nextgen CQC material interpretation. Preserve the adult woman identity, age, slim athletic body proportions, same face and straight shoulder-length pale BLONDE hair with side part shown in the reference. Do not substitute Quiet, do not use orange ColorB hair, do not change her period identity. Retain the distinctive RED molded chest cuirass and articulated red shoulder/upper-arm armor, BLACK fitted tactical underlayer, black gloves, compact black armored hip/utility pouches, high red leg protection and the distinctive small red armored ankle/foot equipment. Keep the actual original garment shapes and color blocking from the first standing reference figure. Improve engineering/material detail: precise fasteners and plate joints, restrained red ceramic gloss, subtle black fabric weave, worn leather pouches, clean rubber soles. A neutral professional full-body standing stance, arms resting naturally, head looking right. No seductive pose, no new exposed outfit, no large weapon, no armor/body copied from Raiden, no changed hair or swimsuit. High-quality semirealistic hand-painted 2.5D game-sprite rendering, single figure.

visualReview.note: Physically viewed: adult Venus original ACID2 pale-blonde identity, original red/black plate silhouettes and utility pouches retained, modern material/fastener detail; no Quiet conversion or orange ColorB appearance.
visualReview.limits: Original CQC interpretation based on inspected prior project sources; no canonical outfit or pixel-perfect source certification. Anchor preliminary.
